reporting_year: the DHIS2 annual reporting year; every row's period must equal it
about: Annual DHIS2 results exports from Member Associations and Collaborative Partners. The map uses service counts per topic and per organisation, and programme ticks. Columns and rules only; no data.

rules.why: org units end in the organisation code: '(XX123-0000)', 'Channels (123)', or a digital unit 'XX123-0000' with no parentheses; a sub-unit adds one letter (123A) and is its own organisation

rules.text: Topic selection: a service belongs to a topic when its data element contains the topic label (HIV: 'HIV and AIDS'). Prefix SRV- = direct service, REF- = referral. Data elements starting 'Notes-' are never counted.
Age band sits in categoryoptioncombo (0 - 24 / 25+). A sex split exists for very few organisations: never report it as a network figure.

rules.why: here org units are the organisation name with the code in the LAST parentheses, after a country tag in parentheses
these are tick boxes or yes/no questions, never counts; elements whose name contains 'specif' are free text (checked on the 2025 export, 07.11.2026)

reconciliation: The export of network-wide service and referral totals by category is the reconciliation total for each year. Its file name is misleading: it holds network totals, not one organisation's data. A multi-year export may lack some organisations for some years; confirm by subtraction against the totals, never estimate.
